description:
Visit Mixture of Experts podcast page to get more AI content  → https://ibm.biz/~ute2Pt4qM

Grand Theft Auto VI and Anthropic's trillion-dollar IPO have one thing in common: November 19. The internet has dubbed it “Grandthropic.” But beyond the memes, what does Anthropic's public debut mean for the AI chip market?

This week on Mixture of Experts, host David Zax is joined by Alexis Zamkow, Sridhar Rajagopalan and Kush Varshney to discuss this and more.

Next, OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Wallet, allowing AI agents to make purchases on your behalf. David shares how he let Claude buy an $850 projector, while Kush isn't quite ready to hand over his wallet. What will it take for consumers to trust AI with their money?

Finally, Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion to advance AI-powered drug discovery. The panel discusses how AI can narrow down promising drug candidates and why predicting toxicity may be just as important as finding molecules that work.

All that and more on Mixture of Experts.
title: Anthropic goes public, ChatGPT gets a wallet & AI designs new drugs
